repos.name: infra-config
repos.description: Infrastructure as code and deployment configs

securityTopics.title: Broken Authentication
securityTopics.description: Strengthened OAuth2 flows, added MFA support, and fixed token refresh vulnerabilities across authentication services.

securityTopics.title: Dependency Vulnerabilities
securityTopics.description: Regular updates of third-party dependencies to patch known CVEs, particularly in npm and Go modules.

securityTopics.title: Input Validation & Sanitization
securityTopics.description: Added stricter input validation and sanitization across API endpoints to prevent injection attacks.

securityTopics.title: Secrets Management
securityTopics.description: Migration from environment variables to a centralized secrets manager with automatic rotation.

securityTopics.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
securityTopics.description: Fixed reflected and stored XSS vulnerabilities in user-generated content rendering and form inputs.

securityTopics.title: API Security
securityTopics.description: Refined CORS policies, added request signing, and enforced strict schema validation on all API endpoints.

securityTopics.title: Content Security Policy (CSP)
securityTopics.description: Deployed strict CSP headers across all web properties to mitigate XSS and data injection attacks.

securityTopics.title: CI/CD Pipeline Security
securityTopics.description: Added SAST/DAST scanning to CI pipelines, enforced signed commits, and restricted deployment permissions.

securityTopics.title: Broken Access Control
securityTopics.description: Fixed privilege escalation issues in admin endpoints and enforced role-based access checks on all routes.

securityTopics.title: HTTPS / TLS Configuration
securityTopics.description: Enforced TLS 1.3 minimum, enabled HSTS preloading, and removed support for weak cipher suites.

features.title: Real-Time Updates (WebSockets)
features.description: Implemented WebSocket-based real-time notification system across web and mobile platforms.

features.title: CI/CD Pipeline
features.description: Migrated from Jenkins to GitHub Actions with parallel testing, automated deployments, and rollback capabilities.

features.title: Dark Mode / Theming
features.description: Major redesign of the component library with dark mode support, theme tokens, and responsive layouts.

features.title: Dashboard & Analytics
features.description: Built new analytics dashboard with interactive charts, custom date ranges, and export capabilities.

features.title: Rate Limiting
features.description: Implemented tiered rate limiting with Redis-backed counters and per-client configuration.

features.title: Automated Testing
features.description: Increased test coverage from 45% to 82% with new integration tests and E2E test suites.

features.title: Accessibility (a11y)
features.description: Comprehensive accessibility audit and fixes including ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support.

features.title: User Authentication & Login
features.description: Revamped login flow with SSO integration, session management improvements, and remember-me functionality.

features.title: Internationalization (i18n)
features.description: Added multi-language support with locale detection, RTL layout handling, and translation management tooling.

features.title: Data Export (CSV/PDF)
features.description: Added bulk data export functionality supporting CSV and PDF formats with custom filtering options.

features.title: Health Checks & Monitoring
features.description: Deployed structured logging, health check endpoints, and Prometheus metrics across all services.

features.title: Docker / Containerization
features.description: Containerized all services with multi-stage Docker builds and optimized image sizes by 60%.
